purpose: Four sealed action cases: no training, no new physics, no threshold or test score changes.
selection: Fixed categories in order open-blue/reference/success, lift-pink/reference/success, place-red/held_open/success, place-blue/held_closed/refused. Within each choose lexicographically smallest (root_id,pair_id) not previously used. Fixed target colours promote diversity. No selection by latent errors, query agreement, coordinates or visual appearance.
background: All 338 frozen selected actual boundary states from latent_tsne_20261016; no new sampling.
union: Concatenate 338 background vectors and 4 cases x current/predicted/actual. Alias an actual endpoint to existing background state ID when present; deduplicate exact vector duplicates with shared coordinates. Keep full logical-to-unique map. No jitter or point relocation.
scaling: Reuse frozen 256D interaction AB-training mean/std from previous tSNE (102 AB points). No case or test data changes scaling.

projection.fit: once on full unique unlabeled union

error: mean over256 dimensions of ((prediction-actual)/frozen_AB_std)^2, unitless AB-standardized latent squared distance. Supplement raw latent MSE for crosscheck only.
render: All four panels share one fitted coordinate system and exact axis ranges. Blue circle current, orange triangle prediction, green star actual; dashed orange prediction arrow and solid green actual arrow. Labels may use leader lines, coordinates never shifted.
ground_truth: Only selecting user-requested outcome strata, semantic annotations and posthoc diagnostics. Never model, scaling, PCA or tSNE input.
refusal: Executed place request was refused before controls; settling frames still recorded. Do not describe as mechanical movement failure.
